name: Jam Session at Porta-Jazz
description: Immerse yourself in Porto's vibrant jazz scene with a lively jam session hosted by João Almeida.
longDescription:
On October 9, 2026, Espaço Porta-Jazz hosts a Jam Session, an open musical gathering where musicians improvise and collaborate. These sessions are a regular feature of the Porta-Jazz association's programming, designed to foster musical exchange and provide a platform for both established and emerging jazz talent within Porto. This particular session is led by João Almeida, a figure known in the local jazz community.

Attendees can expect an evening of spontaneous musical creation in an intimate setting. The atmosphere is typically relaxed and collaborative, with musicians taking turns to perform and interact. The duration of the session is usually several hours, allowing for a variety of musical contributions. The audience primarily consists of jazz enthusiasts, musicians, and those interested in live, improvised music.

Admission to the Jam Session is ticketed. Espaço Porta-Jazz is located in Porto and is accessible via public transport. Further details on ticket purchase and specific transport links can be found on the Porta-Jazz website closer to the event date.
